# telnyx_fax_applications (Data Source)

Lists fax applications, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_fax_application`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_application_name_contains` (String) If present, applications with <code>application_name</code> containing the given value will be returned. Matching is not case-sensitive. Requires at least three characters.
- `filter_outbound_voice_profile_id` (String) Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `active`, `application_name`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `fax_applications` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fax_applications))

<a id="nestedatt--fax_applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fax_applications`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Specifies whether the connection can be used.
- `anchorsite_override` (String) `Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.
- `application_name` (String) A user-assigned name to help manage the application.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `inbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fax_applications--inbound))
- `outbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fax_applications--outbound))
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the Fax Application.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
- `webhook_event_failover_url` (String) The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.
- `webhook_event_url` (String) The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.
- `webhook_timeout_secs` (Number) Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.

<a id="nestedatt--fax_applications--inbound"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fax_applications.inbound`

Read-Only:

- `channel_limit` (Number) When set, this will limit the number of concurrent inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.
- `sip_subdomain` (String) Specifies a subdomain that can be used to receive Inbound calls to a Connection, in the same way a phone number is used, from a SIP endpoint. Example: the subdomain "example.sip.telnyx.com" can be called from any SIP endpoint by using the SIP URI "sip:@example.sip.telnyx.com" where the user part can be any alphanumeric value. TLS signaling is supported. SRTP media encryption requires TLS transport.
- `sip_subdomain_receive_settings` (String) This option can be enabled to receive calls from: "Anyone" (any SIP endpoint in the public Internet) or "Only my connections" (any connection assigned to the same Telnyx user).


<a id="nestedatt--fax_applications--outbound"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fax_applications.outbound`

Read-Only:

- `channel_limit` (Number) When set, this will limit the number of concurrent outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.
- `outbound_voice_profile_id` (String) Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.
